label: prop:knot-operator-energy-unique
title: Uniqueness of the knot operator energy
html:
Proposition. Uniqueness of the knot operator energy

The knot operator energy E(\lambda, q) = |u_\lambda(q)| (knot operator energy) is uniquely determined by:

  1. the partition \lambda \vdash k (a classical Young diagram — q-independent indexing),
  2. the substrate parameter q in the generic locus,
  3. the choice of absolute value |\cdot|_v on R (archimedean or non-archimedean).

Uniqueness holds "up to base ring equivalence": the same shadow price evaluated under equivalent absolute values yields equal energies.

Proof. The shadow price u_\lambda(q) is unique in R by LP duality (complementary slackness dictates a unique dual variable per binding constraint). The absolute value |\cdot|_v is unique up to equivalence within each place by Ostrowski's theorem (over \mathbb{Q}). For R \in \{\mathbb{R}, \mathbb{Q}_p, \mathbb{F}_p\}, the base ring itself fixes the canonical choice.
